QUINONES Municipal Vice-Mayor Lubang, Occidental Mindoro Dear Vice-Mayor Quifiones:: This has reference to your letter dated 20 August 2010 requesting for authority to practice your profession as a CPA-Iawyer subject to the limitations set by law. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department has already addressed a similar concern in DILG Opinion No. 49, series ofeooc;. In the said legal opinion, we opined that a Vice-Mayor, who is also a lawyer, is not precluded from practicing his profession for as long as he complies with Section 90 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160). Section 90 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 is the proper provision that applies to a Vice- Mayor with respect to his practice of profession or engagement in any occupation since the Mice-Mayor is a Member of the Sangguniang Bayan. We also opined therein that the requirement of authorization or permission from this Department, the Ombudsman or the Civil Service Commission applied only to appointive Officials within their respective jurisdictions who want to engage in the practice of their profession. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG opinion for your ready reference. Thank you. Very truly yours, JESUS OQUE V Director III Copy furnished: RD ROLANDO B.
